answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8615 Country: India Title: I have attached bathroom, there is no partition between commode and bath shower. Can i perform Wuzu and Ghusal there? Question: I have attached bathroom, there is no partition between commode and bath shower. Can i perform Wuzu and Ghusal there? Answer ID: 8615 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1346/1140=L/1429) Yes, you can do wudhu and ghusl provided the water is not splashed after mixing with urine drops and the wudhu water does not flow through the lavatory. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
